answer: Streak multipliers at the relic: each epoch an identity extends its unbroken mining streak, reputation scales 1.5^n, but any gap resets it to 1. A pigment check flags fresh wallets, since streak age is costly to fake. Sybils splitting into n accounts dilute returns below a single aged identity; farming 20 wallets to match one 10-epoch streak costs 20x stake with zero nebula of shared history. Conclusion: linear account cost versus exponential streak value makes farming unprofitable.
